text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home after shopping, I turn around after hearing a voice that sounds like it's resonating through the sky.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's calling me… The hot spring is calling me! Welcoming me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You can hear it too, can't you, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I reflexively answer her non-sequitur question, but I have no idea what she's talking about.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see. It seems she wants to take part in the raffle. Lucky for her, I just got a raffle ticket from my shopping, so…
choice_data_list: I only have one ticket, but you can have it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! I knew I could count on you! You're the best! Okay, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl faces the raffle machine with a serious expression, as if bracing herself for the biggest test of her own luck.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Our future full of big, passionate dreams hinges on this! Come on, hot spring vacation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl gives the raffle machine a hearty spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I, Seeking the Pearl, have revealed yet another glimpse into the grand possibilities lying in wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Things are about to get busy! There's hot spring water quality to check and gorgeous dinner menus to look into, after all!
choice_data_list: You even want to know about the food?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! Knowing more about the ingredients will give the food an even deeper flavor, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now that we're on the same page, it's time to start our preparations!
choice_data_list: Huh? Wait, what do you mean "our" preparations?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the matter? You're going to the hot spring too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Of course you are!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: When it comes time to show off more of my potential to the world again, I'll be sure to prepare for it by polishing myself in the hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And you'll need to do the same, since you'll be standing next to me through thick and thin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, I'm suddenly part of her hot spring trip. Or maybe including me was Seeking the Pearl's intention from the very beginning.
choice_data_list: Okay. I'll make the necessary preparations.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Good! Prepare yourself so we can sparkle fabulously together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Just you wait! Soon, I, Seeking the Pearl, will make the entire world shine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl holds up the hot spring ticket she received toward the sky proudly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll have to continue to work hard to make her vacation dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm. I see…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That they tricked us.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have an excellent palate, and clearly, they wanted me to taste test this delicious hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What an incredibly roundabout way to make this happen, though… It's honestly quite adorable.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The moment I declare this hamburger steak is scrumptious, it's bound to be become famous and sought after worldwide!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Very well! I'll give this a taste without any further ado!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Time to get cooking, Trainer! Both the meat and carrot boasts a quality that's perfectly befitting of me! You'd best not ruin this meal!
choice_data_list: Wait, I'm the one who has to cook it?!
Wait, I'm the one who has to cook it?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh? Has my sudden dinner invitation bewildered you? Why, there's no need to be shy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We borrow the academy's kitchen, and Seeking the Pearl laughs raucously as we feast upon the deluxe carrot hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! It's as if my future has been revealed!
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Look at this bushel of carrots… I can hear their cheers for me growing louder and louder!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's right! These carrots are none other than my adoring fans, staring at me with stars in their eyes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow, this feels good! All right, Trainer! Let's invite all of my fans back to our humble abode!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! We're in for a treat tonight! I'll cook you all up into the finest dishes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So she wants to bring the carrots back to Tracen… and cook them, even though they're supposedly her fans?! The situation is too bizarre for me to even say anything about it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: La, la, laaa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, seeing Seeking the Pearl hum happily like this is more precious to me than any raffle prize could ever be.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My, what a bold little carrot. Did it want to be by my side that badly?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then I'll make sure it doesn't regret choosing me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And what better to do that than with a glacé sauce? Time to make it the sweetest thing in the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll split it with you, Trainer! Come along now! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl takes off with the carrot in her hand, and I chase after her desperately.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A pack of tissues?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I assume she's upset, so I think of something to say to console her, but…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's this?! It's made in America! I get it now! These tissues were destined to make their way to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. I'll make sure these get home safe and sound with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl happily puts the tissues in her pocket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Except… the tissues weren't made in America. The packaging just has popular American characters on them… But I decide not to tell her that.
